description: Get detailed task info. If a task name is provided do not lookup the task ID, it will be resolved automatically.

include_markdown_description.description: If true, returns markdown_description field with formatted content including image references. Default: false

include_members.description: Include members with access to the task

include_time_in_status.description: Include time spent in each status

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: get_task
